name: Etapp 1: Stenkällegården - Forsvik

distanceKm.sourcePolicy: Use 31 km as the current section distance for research-normalization purposes because the current Skaraborgsleder stage page/PDF and Naturkartan route object agree on 31.0 km. Keep the 30 km and 36 km variants visible until route variants are modelled.

reportedValues.source: OSM relation tag / older overview accounting
reportedValues.notes: Likely includes longer variant via Källebacken and/or branch content.

estimatedTime.notes: No current official stage-specific time found in the completed first pass. Field/route apps treat the full route as a long demanding day; do not import an estimated time until geometry variant is chosen.

difficulty.official: Bitvis kuperad / medel in overview context
difficulty.candidate: moderate to demanding because of stage length and cumulative climbing
difficulty.notes: Official wording emphasizes good paths and some low-traffic road, but the full stage is long. Field reports and route apps rate full-route variants as strenuous/hard.

routeType.variantHandling: Stage has official variants/alternates near Stora Djäknasjön and Stora Kalven/Källebacken. Treat as point-to-point with alternates, not a single unambiguous line.

endpointGapNotes: Start/end endpoint coordinates are high-confidence for the official order.
The single Naturkartan full-stage GPX does not cover the full route and should not be used as the primary route file.
Normalization decision is documented: use a direct-south primary geometry aligned with the 31 km official display and preserve official north/south alternatives as alternates/connectors.
routeGeometry.navigationGrade: available only after normalized primary/alternate geometry is built from official segments and shortcut cross-checks
routeGeometry.planningGrade: available after variant decision and linework stitching

start.coordinateSource: approximated from OSM/Väg 49 junction described by trail PDF and Skaraborgaren timetable
caveats: Operator/trail sources do not publish exact stop coordinates.
No close Västtrafik stop was found at Stenkällegården in this pass.
Skaraborgaren page says timetable applies from 2018-11-05 until further notice and shows limited Friday/Sunday service.
Västtrafik marks the stop point as flexible taxi service in its stop API.
Närtrafik must be ordered at least 1 hour before the selected interval.
Useful for Forsviks brukskontor/industrial heritage side; PDF mentions a Västtrafik stop by Forsviks brukskontor.

parkingAndTrailheadAccess: Stenkällegården is approached from Väg 49 by turning toward Tivedens nationalpark/Stenkällegården for about 2 km; do not assume unrestricted overnight trailhead parking without checking the camping.
Forsvik has official parking at Forsviks brukskontor and by the lock/slussen according to the PDF.
Valekleven-Ombo öar/Djäknesundet can be crowded on fine summer days; Länsstyrelsen recommends parking in Granvik and walking from there.
currentness: Västtrafik line 420 page listed timetable PDFs for 2026-04-07 to 2026-06-14 and 2026-06-15 to 2026-08-16 during the 2026-04-29 access pass.
Västtrafik 400/401 broader access has a current timetable period 2025-12-14 to 2026-12-12 according to the transit lane.

fireplaces: Use only designated fireplaces; stage PDF and protected-area pages repeat this principle.
Known/likely official fireplaces include Stora Djäknasjön, Djäknasundet, Stora Kalven and Iglasjön grill place.
camping: No whole-stage camping permission should be imported.
Tiveden National Park: if entering the park/connector area, tent/tarp/hammock only at designated place for one night 18:00-10:00.
toilets: Djäknesundet / Granvik / Bölets ängar clusters have toilet references, but exact coordinates are uneven.
caveats: Protected-area rules differ; do not encode a single blanket camping/fire rule.
Current fire-ban status changes quickly and must be checked at trip time.

rules: Fire/stoves/open flame only at designated fireplaces.
Camping/tarp/hammock only at designated place, one night 18:00-10:00.
protectedAreas.currentness: Planned controlled burn at Vitalintjärnarna during May-June 2026; exact day weather-dependent.

fireBanStatusAtResearchTime.status: No active fire ban returned for Karlsborg and Laxå in the Länsstyrelsen ArcGIS layer checked by the rules lane.
fireBanStatusAtResearchTime.caveat: Live status can change quickly; protected-area fire rules still apply.

dogs: General Swedish dog restraint period applies 1 March-20 August.
Protected areas may require leash; Tiveden National Park and Bölets ängar explicitly require dogs leashed.
Field sources say Djäknerundan is dog-friendly, but Djäknesundet bathing-place restrictions may limit dog swimming.
huntingAndForestry: Official trail rules say to avoid hiking during moose hunting season; do not encode fixed dates from this pass.
Working forest outside reserves can produce temporary forestry or blowdown issues; keep condition reports current.
closures: No active stage-specific closure/reroute found in official sources during first pass.
No single authoritative live closure feed was found for the whole stage.
faultReporting: For stages 1-3, use Visit Karlsborg / Infocenter Karlsborg and Karlsborg municipality channels from official sources.
Naturkartan route object contact email: vastragotaland@lansstyrelsen.se.

reports: Repeated 2024 reports of fallen trees, mud and obstructions on Granvik/Djäknasundet/Djäknerundan overlap.
2025 AllTrails reviews mostly shifted to good/great conditions, with seasonal mud/ice noted.
conditionReports.caveat: Evidence covers the Djäknerundan/Granvik overlap, not the entire Stenkällegården-Forsvik stage.

reports: Djäknerundan portion is described as clearly blue-marked.
Older Utsidan/Traneving note from 2014 mentioned fading/intermittent orange marks toward Mon; this may refer to old or side-route context.
conditionReports.caveat: Do not use old marking complaints as current closure or reroute evidence.

reports: Pacer route pages show main route and shortcut variants with distances that reinforce variant/shortcut confusion.
Komoot E1 hiker called the reverse Forsvik-Stenkällegården day beautiful but strenuous.
conditionReports.caveat: Use as corroborating evidence only; official route variants must be normalized from PDF/official map/OSM.

sourceContradictions.details: Current PDF/Naturkartan support 31 km; Västsverige overview says 30 km; OSM and older overview accounting support 36 km. Geometry lane found the difference is mostly variant choice between direct shortcut and longer Källebacken line.
sourceContradictions.decision: Use official 31 km display distance; store measured primary/alternate geometry lengths as metadata after normalization.

sourceContradictions.details: The route object advertises GPX, but downloaded full-stage GPX computed to about 16.95 km and did not reach Forsvik. Do not import it as full-stage geometry.

sourceContradictions.topic: Tiveden National Park relation to stage
sourceContradictions.details: Västsverige says stage 1 starts in Tiveden National Park, while Länsstyrelsen indicates the road passes Stenkällegården before the national park boundary. Apply national-park rules only where geometry confirms the stage/connector enters the park.
sourceContradictions.decision: Overlay found no hit for checked official stage-1 GPX components against Tiveden NP. Do not apply national-park rules section-wide unless final normalized route or connector enters the park.

sourceContradictions.details: Generic overview language says fire bans always apply in nature reserves, but individual reserve pages vary: Valekleven allows designated fires, Bölets bans fires, and Bölskullen page did not list a public fire ban.

Several named services in the PDF need current coordinate/opening verification before import: Granviks vattenpump, Klangahamns Fisk, Klangatorp, Källebacken/Undenäs hembygdsgård tap, Undenäs vandrarhem and some cluster toilets.

agents.summary: Confirmed current official section identity, 31 km preference, PDF variant distances, official access notes, rules and official facility list.
Found official Google KML planning-grade linework, incomplete Naturkartan full-stage GPX, OSM main/shortcut relation topology, high-confidence endpoints and variant-driven distance split.
Collected import/pending/suppress candidate facility records with coordinates, sources and proximity caveats.
Confirmed weak start access via pre-booked Skaraborgaren roadside halt and strong Forsvik access via Västtrafik/Närtrafik.
Found recent condition evidence mostly for the Granvik/Djäknerundan overlap, no active closure, and non-official evidence of variant confusion.
Confirmed protected-area rules, live fire-ban status at access time, Tiveden boundary caveat, dog/hunting/water cautions and no found official closure.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: First-section research is strong enough for handoff and candidate normalization. Runtime import still requires implementing the documented variant geometry model and verifying selected facility/service coordinates.

openQuestions: Implement the documented stage-1 variant model: primary/direct-south line aligned with the current 31 km official display, north Djäknatorp/Djäknasundet alternatives, and Källebacken/Undenäs as alternates/connectors.
Harvest all official Google/Naturkartan segment linework and OSM shortcut cross-checks during normalization; do not use the incomplete full-stage Naturkartan GPX as full-stage geometry.
Verify exact coordinates for Granviks vattenpump, Klangatorp kallkälla, Källebacken/Undenäs hembygdsgård drinking-water tap and toilets at Granvik/Bölets clusters before runtime facility import.
Confirm current operation/opening for Stigmansgården, Klangahamns Fisk, Undenäs vandrarhem and seasonal services before importing them as live services.
Repeat protected-area overlay against final normalized variants; do not attach Tiveden National Park rules unless the final route or modeled connector enters the park boundary.

reasonsReady: Official section identity and endpoint labels are stable.
Transit access, core rules, and many facility records have source-backed coordinates.
The stage-1 variant import risk is resolved to an explicit normalization model in import-readiness-resolution.research.json.
blockersForRuntimeImport: Route geometry normalization must implement the documented stage-1 primary/alternate variant model before runtime import.
Some important facility/water/service records need exact coordinate and currentness verification before runtime import.
Protected-area rule scoping is resolved for candidate normalization, but overlays should be repeated against final normalized variants before generated runtime import.
importReadiness.recommendedNextStep: Normalize stage 1 as one official section with a direct-south primary geometry aligned to the current 31 km display, preserve Djäknatorp/Djäknasundet north alternatives and Källebacken/Undenäs alternates, and do not use the incomplete full-stage Naturkartan GPX as main geometry.
